tools.name: get_ticker_candles_by_range
tools.description:
Get intraday OHLC candles for a ticker at 1m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, or 4h.
Supports date range filtering with interval (start anchor), end_interval (end anchor), and session (regular, premarket, postmarket).
Use relative date anchors only for interval and end_interval: 1d, 5d, 2w, 1m, 3m, 1y, or ytd. Do not pass YYYY-MM-DD dates.
Returns payload with data and is_index. Each candle in data has: o, h, l, c (numbers), start and end (ISO 8601, UTC), vol (volume traded during the candle), tv (cumulative session volume at the candle end), market ("r" regular, "pr" premarket, "po" postmarket), ticker.
Use this for intraday chart windows and bar-by-bar analysis.

range.description: Candle aggregation range in minutes/hours, not months. Use lowercase values only.

interval.description: Required relative start date anchor such as 1d, 5d, 2w, 1m, 3m, 1y, or ytd. Do not pass YYYY-MM-DD.

end_interval.description: Required relative end date anchor. An independent upper bound relative to now, not a duration after interval.

tools.name: get_dark_pool_trades
tools.description:
Screen and rank off-exchange (dark pool/TRF) stock prints by size, premium, market-cap, and session context.
Use this for dark-pool block-flow discovery and filtering, not listed-options contract activity.
Supports session scoping (market_times) and relative-size filters versus daily/30-day volume.

order.description: Sort key. Defaults to executed_at when omitted.

tools.name: get_option_trades
tools.description:
Get executed options trades/prints with tape-level filters, including unusual activity, sweeps, and large trades.
Use this for transaction-level flow analysis, not for contract-ranking screens.
Returns matching prints sorted by the requested field and direction.
Do not assume option volume equals open interest or new positioning; describe high-volume activity as unconfirmed until the next OI update.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 200).

is_multi_leg.description: If true, multi-leg trades only; if false, single-leg only; omit for both.

intraday_only.description: If true, include intraday prints only.

tools.name: get_ticker_ohlc_latest_or_date
tools.description:
Get a HISTORICAL daily time series of ticker day-state rows for one symbol, one row per market-open day, ending at date (or the latest market-open date) and going back limit trading days.
Each row includes OHLC, iv_rank, volatility_30, implied_move_perc_30, call/put volume, bullish/bearish premium, net_premium, and rolling 7/30-day call/put volume averages.
Use get_ticker_candles_by_range for intraday bars.

tools.name: get_flow_alerts
tools.description:
Screen for options flow alert hits generated by predefined unusual-activity rules (repeated hits, floor trades, sweeps followed by floor, volume over OI).
Best for rule-triggered event discovery and filtering, not for full raw tape reconstruction.

tools.name: get_greek_exposure_by_strike
tools.description:
Get a ticker's Greek exposure grouped by strike price for a market date, including call and put gamma, delta, charm, and vanna values.
Use this for ticker-level gamma exposure (GEX) broken down by option strike.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, for example AAPL, TSLA, SPY, or NVDA.

date.description: Optional market date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the last open market date.

tools.name: get_gex_levels
tools.description: Get a ticker's key gamma-exposure (GEX) price levels for a market date: call_wall, put_wall, gamma_magnet, gamma_flip, and nearby_flips.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, for example AAPL, TSLA, SPY, META, or NVDA.

source.description: Exposure basis. vol is directionalized volume (default); oi is open interest.

tools.name: get_max_pain
tools.description: Get a ticker's max-pain level for each option expiry on a market date.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, for example AAPL, TSLA, SPY, or NVDA.

tools.name: get_implied_volatility_term_structure
tools.description:
Get the implied volatility term structure for a ticker on a market date.
Returns each option expiration's volatility, implied move, implied move percentage, and days to expiration.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, for example AAPL, TSLA, SPY, or NVDA.
